get.description:
**Description:** This endpoint returns the tracking configurations supported by Stats API. A tracking version identifies the combination of tracking systems and vendor versions selected for a game or non-game event. Each record includes an ID, a description, and configured vendor fields for pitch, hit, player, skeletal, bat, and biomechanics data. **Relationship to tracking-system ownership:** A tracking version and a tracking-system owner describe different aspects of a game's tracking setup: - `trackingVersion` identifies the configured tracking systems and vendor versions. - The tracking-system owner identifies the ownership category associated with that setup. The `owner` field is optional and may be absent from a tracking-version catalog record. When present, it contains a `TrackingSystemOwner`. Use [`GET /api/v1/trackingSystemOwners`](https://docs.statsapi.mlb.com/reference#get-/api/v1/trackingSystemOwners) to retrieve the ownership lookup IDs and display names and to map them to the `trackingSystemOwner` filter values accepted by applicable Analytics endpoints. Because this endpoint is a configuration catalog, an absent `owner` on one of its records does not by itself indicate a problem with any game. To identify games for which a tracking version is selected but no owner is configured, use the `UNKNOWN` filter value on the applicable Analytics endpoint. Report the `gamePk` returned by that Analytics query to VideoStatsSupport@mlb.com so MLB can correct the game settings. A selected tracking version also does not, by itself, guarantee that all expected tracking data is available. **Return Includes:** Tracking-version IDs, descriptions, configured tracking-vendor fields, and an optional tracking-system owner. ---
EXAMPLES
| Description | URL | | :-------- | :-------- | | Tracking versions | https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/trackingVersions |

**Description:** This endpoint returns the lookup IDs and display names used to describe tracking-system ownership. When filtering the applicable Analytics endpoints, use the corresponding filter token rather than the display name or numeric ID. | Lookup ID | Lookup name | `trackingSystemOwner` filter value | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `0` | Unknown | `UNKNOWN` | A `trackingVersion` is selected, but no tracking-system owner is configured | | `1` | MLB | `MLB` | MLB-owned tracking system | | `2` | MLB Club | `MLB_CLUB` | Club-owned tracking system | | `3` | Hybrid | `HYBRID` | Combination of MLB-owned and Club-owned tracking systems | | `4` | None | `NONE` | No tracking-system owner, including games without tracking data | `UNKNOWN` is a valid filter value, but matching games have incomplete settings that need correction. Report the affected `gamePk` to VideoStatsSupport@mlb.com so MLB can correct the configuration. **Return Includes:** Tracking-system-owner IDs and display names. ---
EXAMPLES
| Description | URL | | :-------- | :-------- | | Tracking system owners | https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/trackingSystemOwners |

**Description:**
This endpoint returns statistical streaks. Results can be filtered with parameters such as `streakOrg`, `streakStat`, `streakThreshold`, `streakLevel`, `streakSpan`, `statGroup`, `gameType`, `season`, and `sportId`.

**Return Includes:** biographical and statistical information for a group of players.

**Hydrations:** This endpoint can accept the hydrations query parameter.

**Parameters:**

### `streakLevel` (game vs season)
Use `streakLevel` to choose whether each step in the streak is a **game** or a **season**.
- **`game`** — consecutive games in which the player (or other organization) meets the streak condition. This is the classic game-level streak behavior.
- **`season`** — consecutive seasons in which the stat meets a threshold, for example the most consecutive seasons with 20 or more home runs, or consecutive qualified seasons batting .300 or higher.

### Defining the streak (`streakStat`, `streakThreshold`)
- **`statGroup`** such as `HITTING` or `PITCHING`
- **`streakStat`** identifies the statistic (for example counting stats like home runs, or rate stats like batting average).
- **`streakThreshold`** sets the bar for each game or season to count toward the streak (for example `20` for home runs, or `0.300` for batting average on rate stats).

### Qualifiers (`qualifier`) for rate stats in season-level streaks
For rate statistics you can use an optional **`qualifier`** to control which players are included:
- **`Q`** — qualified players only.
- **`N`** — no qualification filter (default).
- A stat filter such as **`qualifier=plateAppearances(gte=300)`** for custom eligibility rules.

### Examples

- Game-level streak (hitting streak): https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/streaks?streakOrg=player&streakSpan=season&streakStat=hits&statGroup=hitting&sportId=1&limit=10&season=1941
- Season-level streak (20+ HR): https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/streaks?gameType=R&limit=10&sportId=1&statGroup=hitting&streakLevel=season&streakOrg=player&streakStat=hr&streakThreshold=20
- Season-level rate stat (AVG, qualified): https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/streaks?streakOrg=player&streakStat=avg&streakSpan=career&streakLevel=Season&statGroup=hitting&gameType=R&streakThreshold=0.300&limit=3&sportId=1&qualifier=Q

This return is limited to 1000 objects. **Return Includes:** timestamps. **Tracking-system filtering** Use the optional `trackingSystemOwner` parameter to filter results by tracking-system ownership: - `MLB` returns games using MLB-owned systems. - `MLB_CLUB` returns games using Club-owned systems. - `HYBRID` returns games using hybrid systems. - `NONE` returns games without a tracking-system owner. - `UNKNOWN` identifies games with a selected `trackingVersion` but no configured tracking-system owner. `UNKNOWN` is a valid filter value, but it indicates that the game's settings are incomplete and need correction. Report the affected `gamePk` to VideoStatsSupport@mlb.com so MLB can correct the configuration. For more information about tracking configurations, see [`GET /api/v1/trackingVersions`](https://docs.statsapi.mlb.com/reference#get-/api/v1/trackingVersions). For tracking-system-owner definitions, see [`GET /api/v1/trackingSystemOwners`](https://docs.statsapi.mlb.com/reference#get-/api/v1/trackingSystemOwners). If the parameter is omitted, results include `MLB`, `HYBRID`, and games without a tracking-system owner, but exclude `MLB_CLUB`. Only one value may be supplied per request. **Notes on lastUpdated parameters** ***Sort return based on specific metric. Users can sort by 4 metrics:*** Each of the 4 metrics map to the following objects 1. lastUpdatedTime - http://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/analytics/GUIDs?lastUpdatedTime=2019-01-04T00:00:00.007380Z&gameModeId=2&sortBy=lastUpdatedTime 2. lastMetricsUpdatedTime - http://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/analytics/GUIDs?lastMetricsUpdatedTime=2019-01-04T00:00:00.007380Z&gameModeId=2&sortBy=lastMetricsUpdatedTime 3. lastPlayTime-http://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/analytics/GUIDs?lastPlayTime=2018-02-02T16:06:51.704011Z&gameModeId=2&sortBy=lastPlayTime 4. lastVideoUpdatedTime - http://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/analytics/GUIDs?lastVideoUpdatedTime=2019-08-05T14:05:34.353000Z&isNonStatcast=true&sortBy=lastVideoUpdatedTime 1. lastUpdatedTime ~ updatedAt 2. lastMetricsUpdatedTime ~ metricsUpdatedAt 3. lastPlayTime ~ time 4. lastVideoUpdatedTime ~ videoUpdatedAt Description of each of the 4 metrics. 1. lastUpdatedTime ~ Timestamp of most recent update made to an individual play. This includes reassignment of plays or updates to raw data. 2. lastMetricsUpdatedTime ~ Timestamp of most recent update made only to the metrics of an individual play. 3. lastPlayTime ~ Timestamp of when play has started, however this is not frame accurate like startTime,endTime, & pitchTime and can vary between plays 4. lastVideoUpdatedTime ~ Timestamp of most recent update made to an individual play. ---

**Description:** This endpoint returns timestamps reflecting the most recent data corrections made to games. This return is limited to 1000 objects. **Return Includes:** timestamps. **Timestamp filtering** Use one of the following optional parameters to retrieve games based on the type of update: - `lastUpdatedTime` — The most recent update to a play, including reassignment of plays or changes to raw data. Maps to `updatedAt` in the response. - `lastMetricsUpdatedTime` — The most recent update to a play's calculated metrics. Maps to `metricsUpdatedAt` in the response. - `lastVideoUpdatedTime` — The most recent update to a play's video. Maps to `videoUpdatedAt` in the response. **Tracking-system-owner filtering** Use the optional `trackingSystemOwner` parameter to limit the games returned by this endpoint according to their tracking-system ownership. This filter applies to the endpoint's complete result set. It can be used by itself or combined with any of the timestamp filters above. When filters are combined, a game must satisfy both conditions to be returned. Accepted filter values are: - `MLB` — MLB-owned systems - `MLB_CLUB` — Club-owned systems - `HYBRID` — Hybrid systems - `NONE` — No tracking-system owner - `UNKNOWN` — A `trackingVersion` is selected, but no tracking-system owner is configured `UNKNOWN` is a valid filter value, but games returned by this filter have an incomplete configuration. Report the affected `gamePk` to VideoStatsSupport@mlb.com so MLB can correct the game settings. If `trackingSystemOwner` is omitted, results include `MLB`, `HYBRID`, and games without a tracking-system owner, but exclude `MLB_CLUB`. Only one owner value may be supplied per request. For additional definitions, see [`GET /api/v1/trackingVersions`](https://docs.statsapi.mlb.com/reference#get-/api/v1/trackingVersions) and [`GET /api/v1/trackingSystemOwners`](https://docs.statsapi.mlb.com/reference#get-/api/v1/trackingSystemOwners). **Examples** Retrieve games with metrics updated after the supplied timestamp: ```text /api/v1/analytics/game?lastMetricsUpdatedTime=2019-01-04T00:00:00.007380Z&limit=1 ``` Retrieve only MLB-owned games meeting that timestamp condition: ```text /api/v1/analytics/game?lastMetricsUpdatedTime=2019-01-04T00:00:00.007380Z&trackingSystemOwner=MLB&limit=1 ``` ---

**Description:** This endpoint returns the difference/discrepancies between two timecodes in the Gumbo Live Feed using the Diff Patch System. **Return Includes:** Play by play data and player information.

Diff/Patch System: startTimecode and endTimecode can be used for getting diffs.
Expected usage:
1) Request full payload by not passing startTimecode or endTimecode. This will return the most recent game state.
2) Find the latest timecode in this response.
3) Wait X seconds
4) Use the timecode from step 2 above as the startTimecode. This will give you a diff of everything that has happened since startTimecode.
5) If no data is returned, wait X seconds and do the same request.
6) If data is returned, get a new timeStamp from the response, and use that for the next call as startTimecode.

**Required Parameters:** all parameters are required to run this call. If incorrectly called the call will default to http://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1.1/game/531304/feed/live

---
